body:
MG LSA 2-Jan-2017
1435 - Ingested ~150-200 MG seeds CWE+Garlic tek with HI-C Juice
1457 - Slight nausea and slight feeling of throwing up
1522 - Light on my feet and swaying a little bit. Unsure if it's the drug taking effect or simply lack of sleep. (Have been awake for going on 14 hours.)
1657 - Not quite tripping, but I'm obviously not sober. Just exited the restroom and on my way out I decided to take a look at myself in the mirror, and my pupils are significantly more dilated that usual. I'm experiencing very light visuals. Slight trailing and increased sensitivity to light (objects are appearing brighter, crisper, and shinier) however I'm not experiencing and kaleidoscoping. My body high is there, noticeable, but not overwhelming, it's very enjoyable. No vasoconstriction, which is surprising considering the accounts of others who have taken the drug. The feeling of being nauseated is entirely gone.
2036 - Peak subsided ~2hr ago. I forgot to continue recording my experience, however I can still recall that my peak began 15-20 minutes after my prior entry. My body high is significantly less, I'm not sure if I've just grown used to it or if it has gone away almost entirely, but I feel normal. I figure that this is going to be my last entry for tonight as I'm extremely tired, but I can't say that that is because of the drug as I've been awake for an extended period.
